# Sky

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("Sky")`

Sets what the sky shows: six images around the world, the appearance of the sun and the moon, stars and clouds. It applies only directly under `Lighting`, and only the first one there is used. Surfaces also reflect the images and are lit by them.

The direction of the sun always comes from `Lighting.ClockTime` and `GeographicLatitude`, whatever the images show, so shadows match the sun that is drawn. Use images with no sun painted in, or turn `CelestialBodiesShown` off.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CelestialBodiesShown` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the sun, the moon and the stars are drawn. When it is off, only the images and the clouds are drawn; the light still comes from the sun's direction. |
| `CloudColor` | `Color3` | `Color3.new(1, 1, 1)` | read/write | The color of the clouds where the sun lights them. |
| `CloudCover` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How much of the sky the clouds cover, from 0 (none) to 1 (overcast). Clouds drift on simulation time, so they stop while the game is paused and move identically in a replay. |
| `CloudDensity` | `number` | `0.5` | read/write | How thick each cloud is, from 0 (wisps that the sky shows through) to 1 (solid, with dark undersides). |
| `MoonAngularSize` | `number` | `2` | read/write | The apparent width of the moon, in degrees, greater than 0 and at most 60. |
| `MoonTexture` | `Content` | — | read/write | An image drawn as the moon's disc at night. With none, a plain pale disc is drawn. |
| `SkyboxBack` | `Content` | — | read/write | The image toward +Z, before `SkyboxOrientation` rotates the set. If none of the six images is set, the engine draws its own sky from the time of day. |
| `SkyboxDown` | `Content` | — | read/write | The image directly below. |
| `SkyboxFront` | `Content` | — | read/write | The image toward -Z, the direction a camera with no rotation looks in. |
| `SkyboxLeft` | `Content` | — | read/write | The image toward -X. |
| `SkyboxOrientation` | `vector` | `vector.create(0, 0, 0)` | read/write | A rotation applied to the six images together, in degrees about X, Y and Z. Use it to move something painted into the images, such as a mountain range, to where the world needs it. |
| `SkyboxRight` | `Content` | — | read/write | The image toward +X. |
| `SkyboxUp` | `Content` | — | read/write | The image directly above. |
| `StarCount` | `number` | `3000` | read/write | The number of stars over the whole sky at night, from 0 to 10,000. They appear as the sun sets, and they are the same stars in the same places every night. |
| `SunAngularSize` | `number` | `2.3` | read/write | The apparent width of the sun, in degrees, greater than 0 and at most 60. The real sun is about half a degree wide; the default is larger so that a sunset is visible in a short game day. |
| `SunTexture` | `Content` | — | read/write | An image drawn as the sun's disc, lit by the sun's color. With none, a round disc with a soft edge is drawn. |
